question: Should this branch be semantically rebased onto current main's new iOS onboarding and forced-reconnect state owner, or should its useful tests and intent be replaced by a narrower current-main patch?
rationale: Current main already contains part of the requested presentation behavior, while this conflict-dirty branch has unresolved transition defects; preserving versus replacing it requires owner judgment about the current state boundary.

options.title: Refresh this branch
options.body: Rebase onto current main, move the invariant to the current state owner, fix all four transition and action defects, and preserve applicable tests.

options.title: Replace narrowly
options.body: Use a new current-main patch only if it carries forward the same-target, target-switch, setup-progress, action-disable, and clearing coverage before this PR closes.

recommendation.title: Refresh this branch
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, move the invariant to the current state owner, fix all four transition and action defects, and preserve applicable tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history ties steipete directly to the actively changing iOS gateway and onboarding boundary, and the protected label indicates explicit owner handling.
